title: Product Owner / Product Manager | Transportation & Logistics
description:
Job Description: Product Owner / Product Manager
 



 Position: Product Owner / Product Manager
 



 Experience: 6\+ Years
 



 Domain: Transportation \& Logistics
 



 Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan
 



 Work Model: Onsite for first 2 months, then Remote
 



 Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced Product Owner / Product Manager with strong domain expertise in Transportation \& Logistics. The ideal candidate should have experience managing products, business processes, and technology solutions related to logistics, transportation, packaging, business partner management, and dealer management.
 



 The candidate will initially work onsite in Udaipur for 2 months to closely collaborate with the client and business stakeholders. Following the initial onsite period, the engagement will transition to fully remote.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Own and manage the product roadmap, priorities, requirements, and delivery lifecycle.
 



 • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into product features.
 



 • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
 



 • Create and prioritize user stories, product backlogs, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
 



 • Collaborate with engineering, QA, UX, business, and other cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between business objectives and technology delivery.
 



 • Identify process gaps and opportunities for product and operational improvements.
 



 • Participate in product planning, sprint ceremonies, reviews, and release planning.
 



 • Track product progress, dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines.
 



 • Support UAT, product validation, and production rollout.
 



 • Ensure solutions align with transportation and logistics business processes.
 



 Required Experience
 



 • 6\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or a closely related role.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in the Transportation / Logistics / Supply Chain domain.
 



 • Experience with one or more of:
 



 • Transportation Management
 



 • Logistics Operations
 



 • Packaging
 



 • Business Partner Management
 



 • Dealer Management
 



 • Distribution / Supply Chain Operations
 



 • Strong understanding of product lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
 



 • Experience working with enterprise clients and multiple stakeholders.
 



 • Strong documentation, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Experience working with technology/product development teams.
 



 Location \& Engagement
 



 First 2 Months: Client onsite, Udaipur
 



 After 2 Months: Fully Remote
 



  





 Extension: Based on client requirement and performance
 



 Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice periods will be preferred.

title: Global Salesforce Process Owner - Salesforce COE
description:
Date: Sep 23, 2026
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 IVGSSPL Kolkata, IN
   

  

 Req ID: 1771
   

  

 Company: Indorama Ventures GSSPL
   

  

**Description**
**Our organization** 
 :
   

  

 Indorama Ventures is a global sustainable chemical company operating across multiple verticals such as Combined PET, Fibers, and Integrated Oxides \& Derivatives. The Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Kolkata, India supports worldwide operations through centralized IT, Finance and Business process services.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a senior, business\-oriented Salesforce professional to own the end\-to\-end functional process design for our Salesforce process
   

  

 Acting as the functional process owner, you will lead discovery and design decisions, establish common process standards, resolve cross\-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need through solution delivery and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 This high\-impact role is accountable for the functional integrity of the process landscape, the quality and readiness of business requirements, business acceptance of delivered capabilities, process adoption, and continuous improvement. Delivery teams will own technical design and execution; this role will own the business process intent, functional outcomes, and design decisions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Functional Process Ownership \& Design**
* Own the end\-to\-end functional process design for Salesforce\-enabled commercial capabilities, from lead and opportunity management through quoting, contracting, order hand\-off, and customer lifecycle management.
* Define and maintain global process principles, target\-state process models, decision rights, business rules, controls, roles, personas, and hand\-offs across functions and regions.
* Lead structured discovery and design workshops, challenge local requirements, resolve process conflicts, and secure accountable business sign\-off on functional designs.
* Assess process gaps and improvement opportunities using business outcomes, data, risk, control, customer experience, and adoption considerations.
* Maintain clear traceability from strategic objective and business need through process design, requirement, delivered capability, control, and measurable benefit.


**Functional Design Authority \& Governance**
* Act as the functional design authority for Salesforce Sales Cloud and related commercial capabilities, ensuring designs align with enterprise process principles, platform guardrails, and the target operating model.
* Set the functional direction and approve key process decisions while partnering with architects and delivery teams on solution options, feasibility, integrations, data implications, and non\-functional constraints.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and process fragmentation by promoting standard capabilities, reusable patterns, and disciplined exception governance.
* Define functional acceptance criteria, oversee business validation and UAT readiness, and provide final functional acceptance for releases.
* Ensure process controls, data ownership, compliance requirements, and auditability are embedded in functional designs.


**Demand Prioritization \& Delivery Partnership**
* Shape and prioritize the functional demand pipeline with Business Product Owners and the Salesforce Platform Owner based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, dependency, and process maturity.
* Own the quality and readiness of epics, process requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria before work enters delivery.
* Provide timely functional decisions, clarify intent during delivery, manage scope trade\-offs, and ensure delivered capabilities remain aligned with approved process designs.
* Partner with release, testing, data, integration, and change teams to confirm business readiness, adoption plans, process controls, and benefit measures.


**Process Architecture, Documentation \& Adoption**
* Create and maintain authoritative process architecture and functional documentation, including current\- and target\-state maps, capability models, business rules, controls, role and persona maps, decision logs, and functional specifications.
* Communicate process direction, design decisions, impacts, and trade\-offs clearly to senior leaders, process owners, regional stakeholders, and delivery teams.
* Partner with change and learning teams to define role impacts, operating procedures, training needs, adoption measures, and post\-release reinforcement.
* Monitor process performance, user feedback, data quality, control effectiveness, and realized benefits to drive a prioritized continuous\-improvement roadmap.


**Educational Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an advantage.
* Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant certification is preferred and should be supported by strong practical understanding of platform capabilities and constraints.
* Process\-management, business\-analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or agile product certification is an advantage.


**Nice to Have**
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification.
* Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud or Service Cloud.


**Experience**
**Core Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in business process ownership, process design, product management, or senior business analysis, including substantial responsibility for Salesforce\-enabled commercial processes.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex end\-to\-end functional process design across multiple functions, regions, or business units, with authority to drive standardization and resolve competing requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud and the sales lifecycle, including lead, account, opportunity, pipeline, customer, forecasting, and quote\-to\-order processes; Salesforce CPQ experience is advantageous.
* Experience in a manufacturing or complex commercial environment, with a practical understanding of global process variation, controls, customer experience, data ownership, and integration hand\-offs.
* Proven ability to translate strategy and business outcomes into target\-state processes, policies, business rules, functional requirements, decision frameworks, and measurable success criteria.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and decision\-making skills, including the confidence to challenge stakeholders, manage exceptions, and obtain senior\-level alignment.
* Experience governing demand and backlogs, assuring requirement quality, supporting UAT and release readiness, and measuring adoption and business benefits in an agile delivery environment.
* Excellent analytical, process\-modelling, documentation, and executive communication skills; proficiency with tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Sufficient technical fluency to evaluate Salesforce solution options and data or integration implications while maintaining clear accountability boundaries with architects and delivery teams.


**Behavioral Skills**
**Leadership \& Behavioral Skills**
* Enterprise mindset with clear personal accountability for process outcomes, standards, controls, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Able to lead through influence across business functions, regions, and technical teams, including in situations where priorities or local practices conflict.
* Decisive and pragmatic, balancing global standardization, business value, customer experience, risk, delivery feasibility, and time to value.
* Exceptional workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, structured problem\-solving, and executive communication skills.
* Collaborative and outcome\-focused, working effectively with Business Product Owners, process owners, the Salesforce COE, architects, delivery teams, data teams, and change leaders.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.
